capabilities: Collapse or expand all items in supported views via commands
Toggle collapsed state for views that support it
Bind commands to hotkeys or run them from the command palette
Enable or disable individual command sets in settings
Collapse or expand all supported views globally
disambiguation: Not for folding headings inside notes; it collapses item trees in views like the file explorer and tag pane.
extras: Support is uneven per view: Search only supports collapse and expand, while Bookmarks only supports toggle and may be finicky.
intentEvidence: Extends Obsidian's collapse / expand all functions with bindable commands.
problem: Obsidian's built-in collapse/expand-all behavior is not exposed as commands that can be run from the command palette or bound to hotkeys.
summary: Hotkey-bindable commands that collapse or expand all items in the file explorer, tag pane, search, bookmarks, or all at once.
